description: Create dynamic, animated text from your Power BI data. Text From Values lets you turn report data into structured or freeform text — perfect for generating posts, summaries, alerts, or messages directly within your reports. It can even serve as a textual data card where you control the format and style. You can pick from numerous presets or design your own output using a simple yet powerful template language. Animation effects — including confetti, fireworks, curtains, marquee, flip, fade, and typewriter — help you create engaging and expressive reports. New in 3.0: Fireworks animation and Typewriter transition (types each frame character-by-character). Animation timing controls: Hide After, Repeat After, Repeat Randomize, Particle Fall Speed for the confetti family. New template functions: @sum, @upper/@lower/@trim, @today/@now, @switch, @list. Blank preset for animation-only background cards. Auto-translated UI in 27 languages; user overrides still respected. Reorganized format pane with clearer animation subgroups. Key features: Generate text directly from report data for posts, chats, or alerts. Use template-based formatting to define structured or styled output. Add animations and trigger alerts that respond to changing data. Merge similar values and create export-friendly data outputs. Control behavior globally or per column for fine-grained customization.
